name: Deore XT / LX eight-spline bottom bracket
weight_description: Not yet sourced: the manufacturer technical note identifies BB-ES70 and its spline geometry but does not publish an assembly weight. Different spline engagement on BB-M950 / BB-M952 is not treated as interchangeable.

technical_document.title: Shimano 2001 STI technical manual, PDF page 60 / printed page 66: BB-ES70 dimensions explicitly described for Deore XT/LX; eight serrations with 9 mm engagement, distinct from BB-M950 / BB-M952
